title.narrative: Metsi a Lesotho - Rural WASH

description.narrative:
Summary:

The overall objective of this action is to ensure access to sustainable water and sanitation for all as a means for green and resilient growth and promoting peace and security in Lesotho and the region. For this project, its main objective will be:

  1. To Increase access to safe, sustainable and affordable water, sanitation, and hygiene systems in rural communities, schools and clinics, through decentralised structures;
